info.title: UnifyAI Compute API
info.description: Customer-facing contract for the compute job API, mirroring docs/spec/job-api.md. Draft: the job routes exist and validate, but the backend is not built, so every authenticated job route currently answers `501 not_implemented` after authentication and (for submit) validation. Responses marked *Planned* are the contract the backend will honour; they are not returned today. Authentication currently checks only the shape of the key (`Bearer sk-...`); verification against UnifyAPI is planned.

servers.description: Staging. Defined, not yet applied: this host does not resolve yet.

get.description: Operational, not part of the customer contract under /compute/v1; listed so the route table and this document agree.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document embedded in this build.

get.description: Public so the pricing page can render from it. Not paginated: the whole catalogue is returned.
Every cloud the catalogue references, whether this deployment has it enabled, and which SKUs it serves. Sorted by cloud. Public, like /skus.
Public, like /skus. Every curated template (docs/spec/templates.md), including unavailable ones and their reasons, sorted by id. Not paginated.

post.description: Validated before anything is held or persisted, in this order: body parses (`malformed_body`); if `template` is set, it is offered (`unknown_template`) and available (`template_unavailable`), every field sent is overridable (`field_not_overridable`), env keys are identifiers (`invalid_env`) and inputs bind each declared mount once (`missing_input`, `unknown_input_mount`, `duplicate_input_mount`), and the resolved spec continues through the same checks as a hand-written one: `sku` present (`missing_sku`), offered (`unknown_sku`) and sold (`sku_unavailable`), `spec.max_runtime_seconds` positive (`missing_max_runtime`) and at most 86400 (`runtime_over_ceiling`), every entry of `providers` offered by the SKU (`provider_not_offered`), at least one candidate enabled in this deployment (`503 upstream_unavailable`), and, last, the account's quotas (`403 quota_exceeded`; not enforced in a deployment until key verification and the job store are wired). A request that passes validation currently receives `501 not_implemented`. Planned flow: verify key, place a hold on the UnifyAPI balance, persist the job `queued`, hand it to SkyPilot.

200.description: Idempotent replay: same Idempotency-Key and same body returns the original job. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

201.description: Job accepted and queued. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

400.description: Validation failed. `error.code` is one of `malformed_body`, `missing_sku`, `unknown_sku`, `sku_unavailable`, `missing_max_runtime`, `runtime_over_ceiling`, `provider_not_offered`, `unsupported_input_source` (`param` is `spec.inputs[i].source`), or with `template` also `unknown_template`, `template_unavailable`, `field_not_overridable`, `invalid_env`, `missing_input`, `unknown_input_mount`, `duplicate_input_mount`; `error.param` names the field.

402.description: Hold refused: balance below the hold. `error.message` carries the hold amount and the estimate. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

500.description: `internal_error`/`placement_failed`: placement failed for a reason other than the two the API distinguishes; or `internal_error`/`template_resolution_failed`: a template could not be resolved for a reason that is not the submitter's. Not expected in normal operation. With quotas enforced, also `internal_error`/`owner_unresolved` (the key was not resolved to an account) or `internal_error`/`quota_check_failed` (usage could not be read); nothing was submitted.

503.description: `upstream_unavailable`: the SKU is sound but no provider it offers (or that `providers` allows) is enabled in this deployment. Planned: `console_unavailable` when the key cannot be verified or the hold cannot be placed.

get.description: Cursor list, newest first. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default and maximum are not yet specified.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor: the `next` value of the previous page.

200.description: A page of jobs. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.
The job. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

post.description: Requests termination. GPU metering stops when the cancel is accepted, not when the instance is confirmed down. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`.

202.description: Cancel accepted; `status` may still read `running` until SkyPilot confirms. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

409.description: The job is already terminal. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

get.description: Plain-text stdout/stderr, retained 7 days after a terminal state. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start point. Format not yet specified.

200.description: Logs. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

get.description: Files the job wrote under `spec.outputs[].mount`, each with a presigned download URL (ADR-0005, Proposed), owner-scoped like `GET /compute/v1/jobs/{id}`. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`: the route is built, but the binary has no job store or key-to-owner resolver until the console bridge lands, and no artifact storage until its bucket and token secret are configured. *Planned:* `402` instead of URLs while the account is in arrears (ADR-0008).

200.description: Artifacts. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

500.description: `internal_error`: the job could not be read. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

503.description: `console_unavailable`: the key could not be verified; or `storage_unavailable`: artifact storage could not be reached. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

get.description: The job's event log (docs/spec/events.md), oldest first, owner-scoped like `GET /compute/v1/jobs/{id}`. Pass the last id seen as `after` to receive only newer events. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`: the route is wired, but the binary has no job store or key-to-owner resolver until the console bridge lands.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Id of an event of this job; only later events are returned. An id that is not an event of this job is `400 invalid_cursor`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Outside 1-100 or not an integer is `400 invalid_limit`.

200.description: A page of events. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

400.description: `invalid_cursor` (`param` is `after`) or `invalid_limit` (`param` is `limit`). *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

500.description: `internal_error`: the event log could not be read. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

503.description: `console_unavailable`: the key could not be verified; retry shortly. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

post.summary: Upload URL for one output file (job run step only)
post.description: Called by the job's own run step, not by customers: one file's absolute `path`, `size` and hex `sha256` in, a presigned PUT out, valid for at most an hour, that S3 accepts only with `x-amz-checksum-sha256` set to the returned value. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`.

200.description: `<base64 sha256> <url>\n`, so bash can read it without a JSON parser. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

400.description: `invalid_path`, `invalid_size`, `invalid_sha256`, `no_outputs` or `malformed_body`. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

401.description: `invalid_upload_token`. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

409.description: `job_terminal`: the job has ended and its token with it. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

413.description: `file_too_large`: over 5 GiB. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

503.description: `storage_unavailable`. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

post.summary: Write the output manifest (job run step only)
post.description: Called by the job's own run step after its uploads: compute-api lists the job's prefix and writes `jobs/<job_id>/_manifest.json` from what S3 holds. Calling it again rewrites it. Currently returns `501 not_implemented`.

200.description: The manifest was written. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

401.description: `invalid_upload_token`. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

409.description: `job_terminal`: the job has ended and its token with it. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

503.description: `storage_unavailable`. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

bearerAuth.description: The customer's existing UnifyAPI key, the same one that calls api.unifyapi.ai/v1. Currently only the shape is checked (prefix `sk-`, at least 8 characters); verification through the console bridge, cached for at most 60 seconds, is planned.

uploadToken.description: A job's own upload token, from `UNIFY_COMPUTE_ARTIFACTS_TOKEN` in its environment. Valid for that job only, until launch + `max_runtime_seconds` + 2 h, and only while the job is not terminal.

JobID.name: id
JobID.description: Job id, `job_` followed by a 26-character ULID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retained 24 hours. Same key and same body returns the original job with 200; same key and a different body is 409. Planned: the current build ignores it.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, revoked, or expired key. `error.type` is `authentication_error`.

error.message: Provide your UnifyAPI key as 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...'.

NotImplemented.description: Current state: the route exists and the request passed authentication (and, for submit, validation), but the backend is not built.

error.message: job lookup is not available yet; see docs/spec/job-api.md for the contract.

NotFound.description: Job id unknown for the calling key's user; no existence leak across users. *Planned:* not returned by the current build.

RateLimited.description: Per-key rate exceeded: 60 submits per hour, 600 reads per minute (`GET` on the job routes), as token buckets enforced per process. `error.type` and `error.code` are `rate_limited`. Cancel is not limited yet. Retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait, at least 1.

error.message: Per-key rate limit reached; retry after 60 s. See docs/spec/job-api.md, Rate limits.

QuotaExceeded.description: The submit would exceed an account quota (docs/spec/quotas.md). Refused whole, never a partial grant; `error.quotas` lists each limit exceeded with its headroom. No `Retry-After`: when a slot frees depends on other jobs' runtimes. Checked last, after every request error, on the resolved SKU (a template's default counts). Enforced only once key verification and the job store are wired; the current deployment does not return it.

error.message: sku "a10g-24gb-x1" would exceed this account's quota (active jobs: 2 of 2 in use, this job needs 1, headroom 0; hyperscaler GPUs: 2 of 2 in use, this job needs 1, headroom 0). Nothing was submitted or held; wait for or cancel an active job, choose a smaller SKU, or ask support to raise the limit.

ErrorEnvelope.description: OpenAI-style envelope so existing client error handling carries over.

Error.description: `type` is the class (a closed set); `code` is the specific reason. Codes the current build emits are listed per type in `x-error-codes`; clients must tolerate codes not listed there.

message.description: Human-readable; not stable, do not parse.

param.description: The request field at fault, as a dotted path (e.g. `spec.max_runtime_seconds`). Omitted when not applicable.

quotas.description: Present only on `quota_exceeded`: every limit the submit would exceed, with usage and headroom, so a client never has to parse `message`.

build.description: Git commit of the running binary; `dev` when unset.

Tier.description: Trust level of every provider behind a SKU (ADR-0006). A job is never placed outside its SKU's tier.

Provider.description: One place a SKU can run. Order within a SKU is preference order; SkyPilot fails over along it.

context.description: Present for `kubernetes` and `ssh`: the kubeconfig context or node pool.

accelerator.description: SkyPilot accelerator name, e.g. `A10G`, `A100-80GB`. May be empty for a SKU that is not `available`.

price_usd_per_hour.description: Per hour for display; metered per second (`price_usd_per_hour / 3600`, rounded half-up to 6 decimals at settlement).

tier.description: Empty string only on a SKU that is not `available`.

interruptible.description: Runs on spot capacity and may end `interrupted`.

available.description: Listed but not sold when false; submitting it is `400 sku_unavailable`.

note.description: Free-text caveat about the catalogue, e.g. that prices are placeholders. Empty when there is none.

enabled.description: Whether this deployment holds credentials for the cloud (`UPSTREAMS`).

skus.description: SKU ids that list this cloud as a provider.

JobStatus.description: `succeeded`, `failed`, `interrupted`, `cancelled` are terminal. Allowed transitions: queued -> provisioning|cancelled; provisioning -> running|failed|interrupted|cancelled; running -> succeeded|failed|interrupted|cancelled.

source.description: An `https://` URL, public or presigned by you. Anything else is refused with `400 unsupported_input_source` until customer buckets are read through a cross-account role (ADR-0005).

mount.description: Absolute path of the file the run step downloads `source` to, before the command runs.
Absolute directory (not `/`); every regular file under it is uploaded when the command exits, whatever its status. At most 5 GiB per file and 10 000 files per job.

image.description: Container image. Whether it is required is not yet specified; the current build does not check it.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Platform ceiling is 24 hours. Required unless `template` supplies it.

template.description: An `id` from GET /compute/v1/templates. The template supplies the spec and the default `sku`; the body may then send only the fields the template lists in `overridable`, and must bind a `source` to each of its input mounts. See docs/spec/templates.md.

sku.description: An `id` from GET /compute/v1/skus. Required unless `template` is set; with a template, allowed only if the template lists `sku` as overridable.

providers.description: Restrict placement to a subset of the SKU's provider clouds. Default: all of them.

metadata.description: At most 16 string pairs (not yet enforced).

SubmitJobRequest.description: Without `template`, `sku` and `spec.max_runtime_seconds` are required. With `template`, both default from it.

estimated_cost_usd.description: USD as a decimal string, never a float.

settled_cost_usd.description: USD as a decimal string, never a float.

hold_usd.description: USD as a decimal string, never a float.

placement.description: Null until the job is running (planned, R10).

next.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page.

complete.description: False until the job's upload has finished and written its manifest: while the job runs, after a job that ended without reaching its upload (cancelled, preempted, stopped at `max_runtime_seconds`), and after retention deleted the files. `data` is then empty.

truncated.description: The job wrote more than 10 000 files; only the first 10 000 by path are listed.

Event.description: One entry of a job's append-only event log. Also the body of a webhook delivery.

id.description: `evt_` + ULID. The deduplication key: a webhook delivered twice carries the same id.

type.description: One of `job.queued`, `job.provisioning`, `job.placed`, `job.running`, `job.failover`, `job.preempted`, `job.succeeded`, `job.failed`, `job.cancelled`, `billing.hold_extended`, `billing.balance_exhausted`. Clients must tolerate types not listed here.

created_at.description: Unix seconds. Several events can share a second; list order is append order.

data.description: Type-specific payload; `{}` when the type carries nothing. See docs/spec/events.md.

next.description: Id of the last event returned, present whenever `data` is non-empty, so a poller can always resume from it.

mount.description: Absolute path inside the job's container.

Template.description: A named, reviewed job spec a submit can name in `template`.

id.description: Lowercase slug; what a submit names.

image.description: Container image pinned by `@sha256` digest. Empty only on an unavailable placeholder.

image_source.description: Where the image and its licence were checked.

command.description: Full argv; the image's entrypoint is not used.

env.description: Defaults. A submit that may override `spec.env` merges over them key by key.

inputs.description: Mounts a submit must bind a `source` to, one each.

overridable.description: Request fields a submit naming this template may send.

available.description: Declared available and its default SKU is sold.

QuotaViolation.description: One account quota a submit would exceed (docs/spec/quotas.md).

tier.description: Present for `max_gpus`, which is per provider tier.

used.description: Already in use by the account's active or queued jobs.

headroom.description: `max - used`, never negative: the most a submit could ask for now.

Artifact.description: One output file (ADR-0005). Retained 30 days from upload.

path.description: Where the job wrote the file, under one of `spec.outputs[].mount`.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256, verified by S3 when the file was uploaded.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when `url` stops working: at most one hour from the call, sooner if the signing credentials expire first.
